summary:
SL-020 passes at HEAD 3273431. Both obligations that sent attempt 1 back are now in the tree and verified.

**What changed since attempt 1.** Since 2e4eb27, git shows no change under src/FsAnalyser.Core. The only changes are MainWindow's catch, three test files and the design doc. Build attempts 2 and 3 each changed src, so this has been progress, not a loop.

**Build and tests.** eng/dotnet.ps1 resolved the repo-local SDK 10.0.401. A --no-incremental build of the solution gave 0 warnings and 0 errors. All 86 tests passed, none skipped, and %TEMP%\fsa-tests was left empty.

**O-014.** I removed `!cloudOnly &&` from SizeProbe.IsDue myself. AFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsAllocatedIsProbedOnlyWhenItIsWof then failed with Expected 2, Actual 3 probes. I restored the file from HEAD (hash equal), rebuilt, and the affected classes passed 15/15.

**The window's endings.** The engine refuses UI Automation, so I used a throwaway WPF harness in %TEMP% instead. It hosts the product's own MainWindow class (Debug build of HEAD) inside its own process. It raises the drive and Cancel buttons' Click events in-process and reads the outcome TextBlocks. Everything ran on real volumes.
- **O-015, Scan failed:** a root containing a NUL character shows "Scan failed" with `ArgumentException: Null character in path. (Parameter 'path')`, and the pickers are enabled again.
- **Could not read:** a relative path ('Windows'), an empty path, and a missing folder (Windows error 2) each show Could not read.
- **D:\ through its drive button:** Finished, with 527,495 files, 4,189 folders and 97 links. The coverage line reads 125.4 GB in use, 779.2 MB unseen.
- **C:\ through the command-line route:** Finished in 83.6 s, with 3,447,871 files, 666,143 folders and 16,486 links not followed. It showed 959.3 GB in files taking 693.0 GB on disk, and 53.3 GB of the 746.3 GB in use unseen. It listed 599 unreadable folders and a note about 7 probe failures. Peak working set was 638 MiB.
- **Cancel on C:\:** clicking Cancel at 5.1 s gave the Stopped ending 0.2 s later, with a partial coverage line.
- **Z:\ (SMB) through its drive button:** Finished, and showed the note that the drive does not report file IDs, so it fell back to FILE_FULL_DIR_INFO for real.

**Cross-check against an independent walk.** A second harness compares the scanner with a FindFirstFileExW walk plus per-file handle reads.
- **D:\:** 531,781 paths, exact on paths, kinds, bytes and on-disk bytes.
- **C:\Windows:** 355,506 paths identical, 0 kind mismatches, the same 50 unreadable folders, and 55,451 hardlink duplicates with 0 counted twice. One difference: CldFlt1.etl, a log being written during the scan, was 12,288 bytes short. This is the known stale-listing limit for files under 64 MiB.

**The shipped exe.** A fresh single-file self-contained publish produced one 139,756,184-byte exe. Launched on "D:\" with DOTNET_ROOT unset, it ran and was responding with the title 'Filesystem Analyser'. That was observed at the process level only.

**Not reached:**
- a human choosing through OpenFolderDialog
- a FAT or exFAT volume (none was ready)
- the published binary's own window text
- cold-cache timing
- the contents of the 599 folders an ordinary user cannot read. read-denied-folders would reach them; it is requested again, and no grade here depends on it.

Fitness still reports no declared rules; the person deferred this as m3. The architecture rules are held only by ArchitectureRulesTests, 5/5 passing.

Cosmetic: the header reads "1 folders could not be read".

criteria.criterion: 1. Read everything under a folder: only-child subfolder three levels deep, empty folder, zero-byte file, hidden+system files and folders
criteria.how: TraversalTests.ReadsEverythingUnderAFolder passed. Real volumes at HEAD: the path sets for C:\Windows (355,506) and D:\ (531,781) are identical to an independent FindFirstFileExW walk. Whole C:\ and Z:\ scans Finished in the window.

criteria.criterion: 2. List one folder spanning several 64 KiB buffers (~2,000 entries, 100-char names)
criteria.how: TraversalTests.ListsAFolderThatSpansSeveralBuffers passed. The real C:\Windows tree, including WinSxS folders with tens of thousands of entries, matched the independent walk exactly.

criteria.criterion: 3. Append past 65,536 entries and onto a second name page (synthetic)
criteria.how: ScanStoreTests.AppendsPastOnePageAndRollsNamesOntoASecondPage and ScanStoreBudgetTests.FiveMillionEntriesFitTheMemoryBudget passed. A real C:\ scan of about 4.13M entries, hosted in the WPF window, peaked at 638 MiB working set for the whole process.

criteria.criterion: 4. Reach a path Win32 would alter (>400 chars, 255-char component, trailing dot/space, NUL device name) and map a UNC root
criteria.how: LongPathTests.ReachesPathsWin32WouldAlter and the NormalisesTheRootOnce rows, UNC included, passed. Test contact only: no such path was identified on the real drives.

criteria.criterion: 5. Meet a link: junction, dir symlink, file symlink pointing outside, inside and to an ancestor
criteria.how: LinkTests.JunctionsAndSymlinksAreRecordedAndNeverEntered passed. D:\ at HEAD: 97 links, kinds and path sets identical to the independent tag-based walk, so none was entered. C:\: the window showed 16,486 links not followed (not cross-checked at HEAD; attempt 1's whole-C: cross-check found 0 kind mismatches on the same Core code).

criteria.criterion: 6. Count a hardlinked file once: stale first-seen listing, three names in three folders, reverse order
criteria.how: HardlinkTests (3 rows plus TheListingOfTheNameNotWrittenThroughIsStale) passed. Real C:\Windows at HEAD: 55,451 duplicates, 0 double-charged, 0 orphaned. Charged bytes equal the per-handle unique-FileId sums except for one live ETW log (12,288 bytes).

criteria.criterion: 7. Size a file NTFS stores smaller than its length: sparse, LZNT, plain 10,000-byte
criteria.how: OnDiskSizeTests.SparseCompressedAndPlainFilesTakeTheListingsOnDiskSize passed. Real D:\ on-disk total equals the handle AllocationSize sum exactly, and C:\Windows differs only by the one live log.

criteria.criterion: 8. Size a file whose listing says nothing is allocated: WOF, all-hole sparse, OFFLINE, resident, denied WOF probe
criteria.how: OnDiskSizeTests.AFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsAllocatedIsProbedOnlyWhenItIsWof passed, and now includes the 64 MiB OFFLINE file. Removing the large-file cloud guard makes it fail (Expected 2, Actual 3), so the guard is pinned. Real cloud-only check (317 files of 64 MiB or more, none opened) is from attempt 1 on the unchanged Core.

criteria.criterion: 9. Meet a folder that cannot be listed next to readable siblings
criteria.how: UnreadableFolderTests passed. Real C:\ at HEAD Finished with '599 folders could not be read' listed in the window (e.g. $Recycle.Bin\S-1-5-18, Access is denied). The C:\Windows unreadable set (50) is identical to the independent walk's.

criteria.criterion: 10. Start from a root: regular file, missing path, bare 'C:', relative path, junction picked as root
criteria.how: RootTests (all 7 cases) passed. In the window: relative 'Windows' gives Could not read with the absolute-path message, a missing folder gives Could not read with Windows error 2, and an empty root gives 'A root folder is required.' C:\, D:\ and Z:\ roots completed.

criteria.criterion: 11. Cancel a scan: after the third of ten folders, and with an already-cancelled token
criteria.how: CancellationTests (2) passed. Real: the Cancel button's handler raised in-process at 5.1 s into a C:\ scan gave the Stopped ending 0.2 s later, with a partial-scan coverage line and the pickers enabled again.

criteria.criterion: 12. List on a volume without the extended class (FILE_FULL_DIR_INFO, tag from EaSize, no FileId)
criteria.how: ListingFallbackTests passed with the class forced on NTFS. Real SMB Z:\ picked through its drive button fell back by itself: the window shows the 'does not report file IDs' note, with 133,340 files and 15,081 folders, the same counts attempt 1's independent walk matched exactly.

criteria.criterion: 13. Count a hardlinked file when only one name lies under the root and its listing is stale
criteria.how: HardlinkTests.ALoneNameUnderTheRootIsChargedAtItsListingSize passed. It pins the limitation the design recorded (charged at listing size, 0 probes); it does not correct the stale size. Test contact only.

obligations.evidence: offline-large.bin (64 MiB, all-hole sparse, OFFLINE) is in OnDiskSizeTests with a listing precondition and a CloudOnly/OnDisk 0 assertion. I deleted `!cloudOnly &&` from SizeProbe.IsDue myself, and the test failed with Expected 2, Actual 3. After restoring the file (hash equal) it passes.

MainWindow.xaml.cs:142 reads `catch (ArgumentException e) when (e.ParamName == "root")`. Observed in the product's MainWindow hosted in-process: a NUL-containing root (ParamName 'path') ends 'Scan failed: ... ArgumentException: Null character in path.', while relative and empty roots (ParamName 'root') end 'Could not read'. RootTests and ScanStoreTests pin the ParamName contract.

The coverage line was read from the window on real drive roots. C:\ Finished: 'The volume reports 746.3 GB in use, so 53.3 GB of it was not seen by this scan (...)'. D:\: 125.4 GB, 779.2 MB unseen. Z:\: 3.5 GB, 29.8 MB unseen. C:\ Stopped: '...517.1 GB of it is not in this partial scan.'
The Scan failed ending was observed with exception type and message, border #FFC84B4B, ChooseFolder and drive buttons enabled again, and the scanning panel collapsed.
At HEAD, the sums of ChargedSize and ChargedOnDisk equal Totals.Bytes and Totals.BytesOnDisk on real C:\Windows and D:\ (xcheck 'eq totals: True' for both).

CommandLineTests (6 rows) pass. This run did not deliver a trailing-quote argv to the exe and read the result: the published exe launch was process-level only, and the harness passed 'C:\' without the trailing quote. Attempt 1's process-level evidence stands.

not_reached: The published exe's own window text. The endings were read from the same HEAD MainWindow class hosted in a harness process (Debug build, App.OnStartup bypassed); the shipped binary was observed only at the process level (it runs without a .NET 10 runtime, responds, and peaks at 192 MiB on D:\).
Picking through OpenFolderDialog needs a person. The drive buttons were driven by raising Click in-process, not by a human click.
A FAT or exFAT volume: the app's own ready-drive list held only C:, D: (NTFS) and Z: (SMB). The listing fallback was reached only on SMB.
Cancel during a blocked network or cloud call (m7, deferred). Cancel was exercised only mid-scan on a responsive local C:\.

What the 599 folders an ordinary user cannot read on C:\ hold: the part of 'everything underneath' an unelevated scan cannot reach. read-denied-folders would reach it and is requested; no criterion here depends on it.
Cold-cache scan time. The C:\ run was warm: 83.6 s in the window with the Debug build.
Large VM or WSL disks held open and growing during a scan. None was running, and none was started.

Whether stale listings of actively written files under 64 MiB ever reach material sizes. Seen again here: CldFlt1.etl was 12,288 bytes short on EOF and 118,784 bytes on allocation. Attempt 1 saw a 3,738-byte OneDrive log.

A whole-C:\ independent path and kind cross-check at HEAD. Not repeated because Core is unchanged since 2e4eb27, where it was run. Today's C:\ link count (16,486) differs from attempt 1's 16,799 and was not reconciled.
Windows 10: everything here ran on Windows 11 build 26200.

elevation.why: Optional, and no grade in this validation depends on it. A whole-C:\ scan as an ordinary user again could not list 599 folders (569 of them access denied), and the window reports 53.3 GB of the 746.3 GB in use as 'not seen'. An approval would count the entries behind the 107 access-denied folders that are not WER crash-report archives. That settles how much of that gap is real data an unelevated scan cannot see, as opposed to NTFS metadata. The coverage-panel slice needs that number. The criteria only require that unreadable folders are recorded and the scan continues, which holds. Attempt 1 asked for the same list and no result is on record. Decline if it is not wanted now.
